owned_from: owned and tested by this task; the shared Day-0 efficiency harness is its origin, not its contract

source.note: the harness files this task drew from; each shipped file's own digest is below

__init__.py.what: rewritten: the package's contents and ownership

_paired_helper.py.what: customized: the six functions the reference launch and the deadline runner call (cleanup_stale_ipc, spawn_with_retry, _gpu_pids_via_proc, kill_stray_gpu_processes, wait_for_gpu_free_memory, teardown_and_confirm_free), byte for byte from the shared harness under a new header; the rest of the module is not carried

client.py.what: customized: the vLLM adapter and its server-counter flag, the task-bar and ratio-of-medians alternatives of the summary, and the illustrative bar in the help are not carried; the docstring names this task's two copies; byte-identical to /app/eval/deepseek_v4_flash/serving/client.py

deadline.py.what: customized: the relaunch ordering, node deselection, the verifier clock (end-by, END_BY) and the relaunch kill are not carried; the alarm, the plugin's per-node deadlines and report file, and the group runner are the shared harness's: an expiring wall is attributed from the operation registry -- candidate_fail when a running operation is past its public limit, verifier_fault (censored) otherwise -- recorded with the node's report; the group runner marks the running node censored and the rest blocked_by it.

efficiency.schema.json.what: verbatim, with internal comments removed for this release

nodes.py.what: customized: the environment canary, the flush between draws, the task bars, the candidate-only best-of attempts and the relaunch are not carried; the axis loop, the median draw, the sizing and the client invocation are the shared harness's: one axis's draws are one 1,800 s measurement invocation (limits.json), every prescribed draw attempted with the remaining allowance; the pace-derived ATTEMPT_HEADROOM stop and the per-node deadline read are not carried; a median is never taken from a subset; the sizing reads the invocation limit.

reference.py.what: customized: the relaunch and host-state modes and the host-check dispatch are not carried; the identity checks, argv capture, bounded launch with its startup-crash retry, the draws and the teardown are the shared harness's: each axis's reference draws are one 1,800 s measurement invocation, the launch the public 1,360 s startup limit, teardown the public 180 s limit, all from limits.json. Added for this task: the arm-private JIT cache roots (Triton, PyTorch extensions, TileLang) beside TVM-FFI's and FlashInfer's, the snapshot's vendored FlashMLA products checked, and the vendored modules' origins asserted inside the reference tree before it serves

schema_check.py.what: verbatim, with internal comments removed for this release

snapshot.py.what: customized: the reference's vendored FlashMLA built in its own tree after reconstruction by the task's build helper (build_vendor), its products hashed into snapshot.json; otherwise the shared harness's verbatim

operations.py.what: task-original: the operation registry -- every request, invocation, test file and action with its public limit (limits.json), and the attribution of an expiring wall

not_carried.canary.py: the environment canary: this task never set infb.efficiency.canary
not_carried.KIT_MANIFEST.json: the shared harness's release manifest; replaced by this file

note: Every file above is held to its sha256 here by the task's own repository tests; no shared harness release manifest or vendoring tool is read at verify time.
